Yes,
LloydsPharmacy
sells and distributes health technology and at-home medical devices
, including portable and wearable or wrap-around pain relief tools (like wireless TENS machines and pain-relief pens), circulation boosters, and digital blood pressure monitors. They also integrate wearable device data streams into specific clinical pathways, such as their clinical homecare remote patient monitoring systems.
Available Device Categories
Pain Relief:
Wearable and wireless TENS units, targeted stimulation pens.
Circulation and Mobility:
Foot and leg circulation boosters.
Monitoring:
Upper arm and wrist digital blood pressure monitors.
Clinical Tracking:
App-connected vital sign trackers used alongside specialized remote care programs.
